core_architecture_invariance: The 1D-CNN temporal architecture and pure CPU XLA edge runtime remain 100% identical. Scaling to another crop or geography requires only updating the 6-channel NASA POWER/CHIRPS coordinates and the local language SMS template.

kenya_coffee_rust.zero_cost_cultural_actions_swahili: Punguza matawi na kivuli cha miti ili kuruhusu hewa na jua kukauka majani.
kenya_coffee_rust.zero_cost_cultural_actions_french: Éclaircir la canopée et tailler les arbres d'ombrage pour assécher le feuillage.
kenya_coffee_rust.zero_cost_cultural_actions_english: Prune upper canopy and shade trees to increase airflow and solar drying.

cote_divoire_cocoa_blackpod.biological_latency_pre_visual: 10 to 18 days before brown pod necrosis
cote_divoire_cocoa_blackpod.zero_cost_cultural_actions_swahili: Ondoa kokwa zote zilizoanguka na punguza matawi ya chini ili unyevu upungue.
cote_divoire_cocoa_blackpod.zero_cost_cultural_actions_french: Enlever les cabosses momifiées, désherber la base et ouvrir la canopée.
cote_divoire_cocoa_blackpod.zero_cost_cultural_actions_english: Remove mummified pods from tree, weed base, and thin low branches.
cote_divoire_cocoa_blackpod.institutional_partner: Conseil du Café-Cacao / World Bank Côte d'Ivoire Digital Advisory

uganda_maize_fall_armyworm.biological_latency_pre_visual: 5 to 10 days before leaf whorl window-pane damage
uganda_maize_fall_armyworm.key_climatic_triggers: Sudden rain flush following dry spell, degree-days accumulation > 180 DD
uganda_maize_fall_armyworm.zero_cost_cultural_actions_swahili: Paka majivu au mchanga kwenye kiini cha mmea na panda Desmodium (push-pull).
uganda_maize_fall_armyworm.zero_cost_cultural_actions_french: Appliquer des cendres de bois dans le cornet et pratiquer le push-pull.
uganda_maize_fall_armyworm.zero_cost_cultural_actions_english: Apply fine wood ash in leaf whorls and practice push-pull intercropping.
uganda_maize_fall_armyworm.institutional_partner: Ministry of Agriculture, Animal Industry and Fisheries (MAAIF) / AgriConnect
